blocks.prompt: 13. A patient takes a drug every 8 hours. The single-dose concentration (in mg/L) is \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\) where \(t\) is time in hours since that dose was taken. (a) Understanding Contributions: If the patient takes doses at \(t = 0\), \(t = 8\) and \(t = 16\), write the contribution from each dose separately at time \(t = 10\) hours. Then write the total concentration at \(t = 10\).
blocks.explanation:
Is sawal ki jaan yeh baat hai ke har dose apne liye jaane ke waqt se ginta hai.
Diya kya hai? Ek dose ka \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\), aur doses \(t = 0, 8, 16\) par.
Rule kaunsa? \(\tau\) waqt par liya dose \(t\) waqt par \(12e^{-0.2(t - \tau)}\) deta hai; jo dose abhi liya hi nahin woh kuch nahin deta.
Plan: \(t = 10\) par har dose ki "umar" (kitne ghante pehle liya) likho, contributions nikaalo aur jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: har dose \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\), doses 0, 8, 16 par.
Maloom karna: \(t = 10\) par har dose ka hissa, aur kul.
Tareeqa: \(\tau\) par liya dose \(t = 10\) par \(10 - \tau\) ghante se jism mein hai.

Pehla dose (\(\tau = 0\))
\[12e^{-0.2(10)} = 12e^{-2} \approx 1.624\]
Kyun: yeh 10 ghante purana hai, kaafi kam reh gaya.

Doosra dose (\(\tau = 8\))
\[12e^{-0.2(10 - 8)} = 12e^{-0.4} \approx 8.044\]
Kyun: \(t = 10\) par yeh sirf 2 ghante purana hai, is liye abhi zyada hai.
Dhyan dein: yahan \(t - 8 = 2\) rakhna hai, \(t = 10\) nahin.

Teesra dose (\(\tau = 16\))
\(t = 10\) tak liya hi nahin gaya: hissa 0.

Kul
\[C_{\text{total}}(10) = 12e^{-2} + 12e^{-0.4}\]
\[\approx 1.624 + 8.044 = 9.668\text{ mg/L}\]
Kyun: alag alag doses ke concentrations jama hote hain.
blocks.final_answer: \(t = 10\) par hisse: \(12e^{-2} \approx 1.624\) (pehla dose), \(12e^{-0.4} \approx 8.044\) (doosra dose), 0 (teesra dose). Kul \(= 12e^{-2} + 12e^{-0.4} \approx 9.668\) mg/L.

blocks.prompt: 13. A patient takes a drug every 8 hours. The single-dose concentration (in mg/L) is \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\) where \(t\) is time in hours since that dose was taken. (b) Common Mistake: A student calculates concentration at \(t = 10\) as \(12e^{-0.2\times 10} \approx 1.624\) mg/L. What is wrong with this calculation?
blocks.explanation:
Student ki value ko part (a) se milaiye.
Diya kya hai? Student ne \(12e^{-0.2\times 10} \approx 1.624\) nikala.
Sawal yeh hai: student ne kaunsa dose gina aur kaunsa chhor diya?
Plan: part (a) ki dose-war list se muqabla.
steps:
Diya gaya: student ki value \(12e^{-0.2\times 10} \approx 1.624\) mg/L.
Maloom karna: ghalti kya hai.
Tareeqa: part (a) ki list se muqabla.

Student ne kya gina
\(12e^{-0.2\times 10}\) sirf pehle dose ka hissa hai (jo 10 ghante pehle liya gaya).
Kyun: formula mein \(t = 10\) seedha rakha, jo sirf \(t = 0\) wale dose par sahi baithta hai.

Kya chhoot gaya
Doosra dose, jo \(t = 8\) par liya gaya, 2 ghante se jism mein hai aur \(12e^{-0.4} \approx 8.044\) mg/L deta hai; yahi bara hissa hai.

Sahi value
\[12e^{-2} + 12e^{-0.4} \approx 9.668\text{ mg/L}\]
jo student ki value ka taqreeban chhe guna hai. Is ghalti se doctor samajh sakta hai ke dawai khatam ho rahi hai, jab ke asal mein kaafi maujood hai.
blocks.final_answer: Student ne sirf pehla dose gina aur doosra dose (\(t = 8\) par liya gaya) bhool gaya, jo \(12e^{-0.4} \approx 8.044\) mg/L deta hai. Sahi concentration \(12e^{-2} + 12e^{-0.4} \approx 9.668\) mg/L hai.

blocks.prompt: 13. A patient takes a drug every 8 hours. The single-dose concentration (in mg/L) is \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\) where \(t\) is time in hours since that dose was taken. (c) Just Before V/S Just After a Dose: Calculate (i) Concentration just before the third dose at \(t = 16\) hours.
blocks.explanation:
"Just before" ka matlab: teesra dose abhi liya nahin gaya.
Diya kya hai? \(t = 16\) se zara pehle sirf do doses jism mein hain: pehla 16 ghante purana, doosra 8 ghante purana.
Plan: dono ke hisse jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: 0 aur 8 par doses liye ja chuke; teesra \(t = 16\) par lene wale hain.
Maloom karna: \(t = 16\) se zara pehle \(C\).
Tareeqa: dono doses ke hisse un ki umar 16 aur 8 ghante ke saath jama.

Dono doses jama karein
\[C_{\text{before}} = 12e^{-0.2(16)} + 12e^{-0.2(8)}\]
\[= 12e^{-3.2} + 12e^{-1.6}\]
\[\approx 0.489 + 2.423 = 2.912\text{ mg/L}\]
Kyun: \(0.2 \times 16 = 3.2\) aur \(0.2 \times 8 = 1.6\). Dhyan dein: yeh MEC jaisi kam value ke qareeb hai, isi liye agla dose zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: 13. A patient takes a drug every 8 hours. The single-dose concentration (in mg/L) is \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\) where \(t\) is time in hours since that dose was taken. (c) Just Before V/S Just After a Dose: Calculate (ii) Concentration just after the third dose at \(t = 16\) hours.
blocks.explanation:
"Just after" ka matlab: teesra dose abhi abhi liya gaya.
Naya dose zero ghante purana hai, to woh apni poori shuru wali value \(12e^{0} = 12\) deta hai.
Plan: part (c)(i) ki value mein 12 jama karo.
steps:
Diya gaya: part (c)(i) aur \(t = 16\) par naya dose.
Maloom karna: \(t = 16\) ke foran baad \(C\).
Tareeqa: naye dose ki umar 0, is liye hissa \(12e^{0} = 12\).

Naya dose jama karein
\[C_{\text{after}} = 12e^{-3.2} + 12e^{-1.6} + 12\]
\[\approx 2.912 + 12 = 14.912\text{ mg/L}\]
Kyun: dose lete hi concentration 12 mg/L ek dam upar chala jata hai; graph mein yahan seedhi chhalang (jump) hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: 13. A patient takes a drug every 8 hours. The single-dose concentration (in mg/L) is \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\) where \(t\) is time in hours since that dose was taken. (d) General Formula: Write the general formula for \(C_{\text{total}}(t)\) for \(16 \le t \le 24\), i.e., after 3 doses have been given.
blocks.explanation:
\(16 \le t \le 24\) mein teeno doses jism mein hain.
Rule kaunsa? Har dose ka hissa \(12e^{-0.2(t - \tau)}\), apni umar ke saath.
Plan: teen terms jama karo; chahein to \(e^{-0.2t}\) common nikaal kar chhoti shakal bhi likh lo.
steps:
Diya gaya: doses 0, 8, 16 par; har dose \(C(t) = 12e^{-0.2t}\).
Maloom karna: \(16 \le t \le 24\) ke liye \(C_{\text{total}}(t)\).
Tareeqa: \(\tau\) par liya dose \(12e^{-0.2(t - \tau)}\) deta hai.

Teeno hisse jama karein
\[C_{\text{total}}(t) = 12e^{-0.2t} + 12e^{-0.2(t - 8)} + 12e^{-0.2(t - 16)}\]
Kyun: pehla dose \(t\) ghante purana, doosra \(t - 8\), teesra \(t - 16\).
Dhyan dein: doosre aur teesre dose mein \(t\) khud nahin, balke \(t - 8\) aur \(t - 16\) rakhna hai.

Tasdeeq
\(t = 16\) par: \(365.83e^{-3.2} \approx 14.91\), jo (c)(ii) se milta hai \(\checkmark\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key yeh formula do plus signs ke saath chhapti hai, "\(12e^{-0.2(t-8)} + + 12e^{-0.2(t-16)}\)"; sirf ek plus hona chahiye: \(C_{\text{total}}(t) = 12e^{-0.2t} + 12e^{-0.2(t-8)} + 12e^{-0.2(t-16)}\).
